**Best for:** cost-conscious travellers without their own board; straightforward lakefront camping; reliable access to a dedicated rental operator.  
**Downside:** simpler facilities than the resort sites; only small dogs (max one) are listed in the current tariff.

---

## 5. Camping Iseo — best quiet sandy beach; no dogs

**Location:** Via Ippolito Antonioli 57, Iseo  
**Official website / booking:** https://www.campingiseo.it/en/home-english/  
**2026 season:** 28 March–18 October *(confirmed independently on Camping Iseo’s own 2026 tariff page)*  
**Scale:** 56 pitches

Camping Iseo is a genuinely separate site from neighbouring Camping Quai. Its official site describes a **fine-sand beach with a gentle gradient**, two lake-access ramps/jetties and a very quiet, garden-like setting. This is arguably one of the best places for launching your own SUP, especially if you prefer sand to a wall, steps or pebble edge.

Peak 2026 pricing is **€28 small pitch, €36 medium, €40 lakefront, €54 XL**, plus **€14.50 per adult and €3 electricity**. A lakefront pitch for two adults therefore comes to roughly **€72/night before tourist tax**.

Rules are stricter than elsewhere: **dogs are not allowed**, ACSI is not accepted, and the site says tents/closed awnings/grass carpets are not accepted.


**2 September booking note:** Live inventory is not publicly exposed; confirm directly. The campsite remains in its top tariff period on 2 September. See the consolidated availability/price table above.

**Official site:** https://www.campingiseo.it/en/home-english/

**Best for:** quiet couples, own-SUP users, sandy/shallow access, walking into Iseo.  
**Downside:** no dogs, strict camping rules, relatively high peak-season total price.

---

## 6. Camping Cave — best pet-friendly Pilzone alternative

**Location:** Via Cave 13, Pilzone d’Iseo (municipality of Iseo, BS)  
**Official website / booking:** https://www.campingcave.it/en/  
**2026 season:** 30 April–4 October

Cave has a grassy lakeside setting, shade and a more traditional campsite feel. Its standard pitch is about **7.0 × 6.5 m**, includes **4A electricity**, and recent booking-site reviews rate the scenery, staff and restaurant highly.

Peak 2026 prices mirror Pilzone closely: **€25 standard, €30 lake zone, €34 first row**, plus **€13 per adult**. For two adults, a first-row pitch is roughly **€60 before tourist tax**. Pets are allowed.

Lagovivo at Via Cave 1 is nearby for SUP rental. A practical caution from recent camper reviews is that access can feel narrow and pitches are not particularly large, so this is less attractive for very large motorhomes.


**2 September booking note:** No dependable public date-specific pitch inventory is exposed; check the booking channel or contact the site directly. Published pricing is in the comparison table above.

**Official tariff:** https://www.campingcave.it/listino-prezzi/

**Best for:** pets, shade, quieter/simple camping, nearby SUP rental.  
**Downside:** 4A electrical supply, modest pitch size, tighter access than some Iseo-town sites.

---

## 7. Camping Quai — simple, family-run and directly lakeside

**Location:** Via Ippolito Antonioli 73, Iseo  
**Official website / booking:** https://campingquai.it/  
**2026 season:** 24 April–11 October

Quai is a separate, family-run lakeside campsite with transparent pricing. For **2 September**, its MID-season rates are **€33 lakefront, €29 second row, €26 XL, €23 central and €20 fourth row**, plus **€12 per adult**, €1 tourist tax per adult and roughly €2–3/day for electricity. The higher July–August MAX rates are €36 / €32 / €29 / €26 / €22 respectively.

Recent camper reviews praise the friendliness, sanitary facilities, restaurant and proximity to Iseo. One useful caveat is that several reviewers describe the actual beach area as limited; the lakefront pitches get the best water views.

Crucially for this trip, Quai **does have its own SUP/kayak rental**. The current official tariff is **€10 for 1 hour, €18 for 2 hours, €25 for 3 hours, €32 for 4 hours or €37 for a full day** for a SUP/single kayak. The campsite recommends reserving the equipment **at least one day in advance at reception**.


**2 September booking note:** Exact availability requires a direct request. Advance bookings normally require three nights (four for lakefront); for shorter stays the campsite explicitly recommends calling the day before to ask about gaps. See the consolidated price table above.

**Booking / price list:** https://campingquai.it/en/price-list/ · info@campingquai.it · +39 030 9821610

**Best for:** simple lakeside camping near town, people who like small family-run sites, and travellers who want **on-site SUP rental with published prices and advance-reservation guidance**.  
**Downside:** limited beach compared with Camping Iseo/Punta d’Oro; published SUP fleet size is unknown.

---

## 8. Riva di San Pietro — best Marone / northern-east-shore base

**Location:** Via Battista Cristini 5, Marone  
**Official website / booking:** https://www.rivasanpietro.it/  
**2026 season:** 9 May–30 September  
**Scale:** 110 pitches

Riva di San Pietro sits directly on the lake and has electricity on all pitches, two pools, restaurant/bar, bicycle rental and pedal-/motor-boat rental. It is a good base if you want to spend more time in the northern half of the lake rather than around Iseo town.
